pages.text: Every Ender Dragon drops one $(item)Dragon Soul$() at the feet of its killer, or on top of the exit portal pillar if no player killed it.$(br2)The Origin Dragon sword and chestplate need one each.

After the Ender Dragon falls, a 20-second countdown begins in the End. Then lightning strikes and the $(l)Divine Heavenly Dao$() descends above the main island.$(br2)Bring at least Origin Dragon gear.
